title: BattleFrame: GREATHELM
description: GREATHELM ruleset for the BattleFrame system. Implements only the mechanics of the game engine (dice pool, action selection, round loop) -- it ships no rules text, stat blocks, or artwork. Requires the official GREATHELM rulebook (Malev, greathelm QSR / full rulebook), obtained separately by the user; none of its content is redistributed here.
